When I met Dr Ruby Basson, she listened to me and told me what she thought was wrong with me.

Then, she asked me a question that I do not believe any GP has asked me before - "what do you think will help you recover."

I told her and based on that she offered me options for two medications and explained why she was leaning towards a specific one.

Based on her explanations, I agreed that the medication appears to be the best option for my situation.

After that, Dr Basson carefully explained the side effects to me. This turned out to be very helpful because when I started on the medication, I experienced those side effects - which were horrible.

However, because she already told me that I may experience those side-effects and that they will eventually ease off, I was able to hang on and eventually the side effects cleared and I GOT MY LIFE BACK.

I have not felt this good in 3 years.

A big thank you to Dr Basson and everyone at Ladybarn Group practice.",null,[0,147]]]],[null,1718614238000000,1718614238000000,"a year ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTk1Oazh5Y1VKUkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you so much for leaving such a lovely review to us and we are so pleased to hear about your kind words about Dr. Bassoon and you were happy with the care she provided. All the staff are professional and do their best under challenging circumstances.

The legendary Dr C Ronalds was my GP and always ran late. Why? She made time for everyone, so I never minded waiting to see her. I too on some occasions took up 20 minutes or more.

I could have left the practice when Dr Ronalds did. I chose not to as the other Drs are also excellent.

Yes, problems are getting through in the morning but if it is to make an appointment which is not urgent, its best done online. If everyone that can do using the online services, the pressures on reception might ease in the morning.
It's not something that can be solved by merely hiring more receptionists; they would need a small army at peak hours.

Somehow, the Drs that have worked there over the last 33 years have been, without exception, perfect. I doubt you would do better with any other practice in Manchester.

Please keep up the fantastic service.
Kais Uddin",null,[0,115]]]],[null,1656076951000000,1656076951000000,"3 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/2795546794232659580/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTnZiRFV5YjBkM0VBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Kais,
